steps.title: Configure Application Metadata
steps.description: Establish the Simple Calculator project information including package definition com.simplecalculator.app.

steps.description: Set compiler and build environment configurations targetting Android SDK 34 and Java 8 compatibility inside build.gradle.

steps.description: Establish the application package, define MainActivity, map launch intent, and bind application drawable icons inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Design Responsive Layout UI
steps.description: Draft a lightweight nested LinearLayout structure to establish standard screen compatibility for digital keypad buttons and outputs.

steps.title: Create Formula and Result Panels
steps.description: Add UI labels representing currently built expressions and evaluation outputs, featuring proper scrolling and alignment values.

steps.title: Construct Calculator Keys Grid
steps.description: Build numeric, operator, and action buttons within a clean structured linear row setup with equalized visual weights.

steps.title: Initialize MainActivity Class
steps.description: Declare the com.simplecalculator.app namespace and structure the controller with listener registrations.

steps.title: Implement Button Interactions
steps.description: Bind click listeners to views using standard compatible Java 8 architecture.

steps.title: Write Numerical Appending Engine
steps.description: Design character typing limits, initial state zero handling, and dynamic expression appending controls.

steps.title: Develop Decimal State Controller
steps.description: Integrate intelligent decimal checking logic allowing only single dot notations in currently typed float parts.

steps.title: Create Operator Insertion Rules
steps.description: Implement checks prevents consecutive operators from breaking formula syntax by replacing symbols in-place.

steps.title: Code Backspace and Eraser System
steps.description: Build clearing commands resetting state models and backspace logic trimming inputs.

steps.title: Implement Expression Parser
steps.description: Code recursive-descent math expression analyzer handling order of operations like multi-div before plus-minus.

steps.title: Write Division Safety Protocols
steps.description: Add zero divisor logic checks returning 'Error' immediately to prevent crashes.

steps.title: Polish Number Formatting Output
steps.description: Integrate DecimalFormat truncating long trailing floating fractions for pristine aesthetics on final outputs.

steps.title: Validate Android Resource Schemas
steps.description: Perform sanity audits verifying valid Android-namespace and layout resource paths across source files.

steps.title: Building Simple Calculator
steps.description: Verify build completeness and compile the Simple Calculator project.
